versions.content: Dealing with availability of Events The Dem shall treat an event as unavailable if: • DemEventAvailableInVariant == FALSE or • DemEventAvailable == FALSE or • DemEventAvailable is overwritten by Dem_SetEventAvailable (FALSE) or • The component referenced by DemComponentClassRef is not available
